en.providerCard.chatgptDisconnect: Disconnect ChatGPT? TALOS will stop using your plan.
en.providerCard.chatgptAfter: Disconnected: the plan models stop answering
en.providerCard.exclude: TALOS wants OpenRouter to skip {name} for every model.
en.providerCard.excludeForModel: TALOS wants OpenRouter to skip {name} again for {model}, as it does by default.
en.providerCard.allow: TALOS wants OpenRouter to use {name} again.
